deck: TRACE THE DUTY. PROVE THE CLAIM.
site_ui.lead: Find recoverable dollars in import records, tariff classifications, and antitrust settlements before the filing windows close.
site_ui.summary: Eligible drawback can return up to 99% of qualifying duties, taxes, and fees, but document completeness, exclusions, and processing time determine whether a recovery engagement earns its margin. Build distinct revenue lanes around drawback administration, legally supportable tariff refunds, and antitrust settlement claims support, pricing each against verified eligibility, collection timing, and the applicable representation rules.
flow: Identify authorized importers, exporters, and settlement claimants with material, documentable recovery potential.
Separate drawback, tariff-refund, and antitrust matters; verify standing, exclusions, and filing deadlines.
Match entries, duty payments, exports, purchases, and settlement evidence without double-counting recovery.
Prepare auditable claim files with qualified customs professionals or counsel where required.
Submit through the proper authorized channel and track inquiries, corrections, and determinations.
Reconcile actual proceeds, invoice contracted fees, and retain evidence for audits and overlapping-claim checks.
